items.title: How BMW Group accelerated connected vehicle workloads on AWS Graviton
items.summary: Learn how BMW Group migrated its connected vehicle platform from x86 to AWS Graviton. Using Karpenter, multi-architecture container builds, and Graviton-based CI/CD runners, the team moved workloads without disruption, cutting NGINX ingress CPU by about 57 percent and delivering about 40 percent better price-performance.
items.creator: Tomislav Lozančić
